The Penitents are a group of man'ari eredar led by Arzaal who wish redemption for their past sins and were allowed to join the draenei. Few have been allowed to serve the draenei on Azeroth, not out of distrust—since Arzaal personally evaluates each Penitent and vouches for them with his own life—but to avoid causing them distress over what the man'ari once did to them. Player characters that use the man'ari customization are considered members of the Penitents. Arzaal is thankful for their part in aiding to foster trust with the draenei.

Peculiar Key is part of the Incognitro, the Indecipherable Felcycle acquisition secret. Combine the Inert Peculiar Key found at at Marshal's Refuge in Un'Goro Crater with the Peculiar Gem at at the bottom of Pillar-nest Vosh in Azj-Kahet (found in Ratts' Race) to form this key. Take the key and the Torch of Pyrreth to on the bottom of the eastern side of the exterior of Karazahn's tower in Deadwind Pass to enter the Ratts' Revenge scenario. "Winter", as classified by the game, seems to run from December 21st to June 21st and "Summer" is June 21st to December 21st. Phero-Escape is sold by Llyot, Tulumun, and Yamas the Provider for 25 Kej.
Phase Stalkers are warp stalkers located in the Wastes of K'aresh in Manaforge Omega.
Phaseblade Bandits are void ethereals located at Shadow Point on K'aresh. They can only be seen while Phase Diving.
Petulant Pumpkins are squashlings found at the Heartland in the Valley of the Four Winds. Only their head sticks out above the ground until attacked.
Phantasmal Weapons are animated swords that are summoned by Councilor Gorluk at the Throne of the Imperator in Highmaul.
